confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings; 2026 prices are projected. Accommodation anchors are least certain because of seasonal and event-driven swings. Yen figures were converted at an assumed rate of about 150 JPY per USD, not a live rate. Menu prices assume Japan's usual tax-inclusive pricing with no service charge. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor (about 1.4x and 1.1x) because direct knowledge of bar and wine prices is weak. The FX observation came from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rate table; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used. Based on general Japanese pricing for a mid-sized tourist city, priced somewhat below Tokyo and Osaka for restaurants and hotels.
